name: What financial metrics are essential for evaluating cash flow properties?

mainEntity.name: What financial metrics are essential for evaluating cash flow properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beyond cash flow, essential metrics include the capitalization rate (cap rate), cash-on-cash return, gross rent multiplier (GRM), and debt service coverage ratio (DSCR). Each provides a different perspective on profitability and risk. For example, cash-on-cash return assesses the annual pre-tax cash flow relative to the actual cash invested. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution emphasizes analyzing these metrics to make informed investment decisions, tailored to the specific characteristics of properties in regions like Palm Beach County.
